# scc_compliance_case (Resource)

Manages the ComplianceCase object via New-ComplianceCase / Get-ComplianceCase / Set-ComplianceCase / Remove-ComplianceCase.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scc_compliance_case" "investigation" {
  name        = "acme-hr-2026-014"
  description = "HR investigation case"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Optional

- `add_or_update_sources` (Boolean) Maps to the -AddOrUpdateSources parameter.
- `case_type` (String) Maps to the -CaseType parameter.
- `close` (Boolean) Maps to the -Close parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `external_id` (String) Maps to the -ExternalId parameter.
- `remove_sources` (Boolean) Maps to the -RemoveSources parameter.
- `reopen` (Boolean) Maps to the -Reopen parameter.
- `secondary_case_type` (String) Maps to the -SecondaryCaseType parameter.
- `source_case_type` (String) Maps to the -SourceCaseType parameter.
- `sources` (Set of String) Maps to the -Sources parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
